title: Borlotti Bean Pasta
description: A simple yet flavorful French-inspired pasta dish made with borlotti beans and wholesome ingredients. This hearty recipe is perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the garlic and onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the borlotti beans to the skillet and stir to combine with the garlic and onion mixture.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss with the bean mixture.
Sprinkle the rosemary over the pasta and toss to combine.
